legal.title: Legal
legal.impressumText:
Flyary — Digital logbook for paragliding pilots

Responsible:
Tobias Bolliger
Email: tobias.a.bolliger@gmail.com
legal.privacyIntro: Protecting your personal data is important to us. Below we inform you about how your data is collected and used.
legal.dataCollectionText: We store the data you enter in the app: email address, profile information, flight data, locations, and group information.
legal.dataUsageText: Your data is used solely to provide the app's features. No data is shared with third parties for advertising purposes.
legal.dataStorageText: Data is stored on secure servers in the EU and transmitted encrypted.
legal.rightsText: You have the right to access, correct, and delete your personal data at any time. Contact us through the app.
legal.contactText: For privacy-related questions, please contact the app operator.
legal.termsIntro: These terms govern the use of Flyary, operated by Tobias Bolliger as a private individual.
legal.termsScopeText: Flyary is a digital flight log for paragliding pilots. Use is voluntary and at your own risk.
legal.termsAccountText: You are responsible for the security of your account and the accuracy of the data you enter.
legal.termsLiabilityText: Flyary is NOT a navigation or safety system. Flight planning, weather assessment and safety decisions are solely the pilot's responsibility. We accept no liability for damages arising from use of the app, displayed weather data or maps.
legal.termsContentText: You retain all rights to your uploaded content (photos, tracks, comments). You grant Flyary the right to store and display them within the app's features.
legal.termsTerminationText: You can delete your account at any time via settings. All your data will then be permanently removed.
legal.termsLawText: Swiss law applies. Place of jurisdiction is the operator's residence.
legal.licensesIntro: Flyary uses numerous open-source libraries. We thank the maintainers for their work.
